comment: TS version matrix for the fixture harness. Each entry becomes an isolated fixture project with its own pinned TypeScript and its own installed tarball of the built packages. Every `typescript` value is an exact pin, never a dist-tag: a floating tag silently redefines what a lane measures, which is how the top lane started type-checking against the 7.x compiler without anyone choosing that. New compiler generations get their own lane instead. `packages` must list every @cancjs package that any fixture imports. A missing name does not fail loudly: resolution walks up to the hoisted workspace symlink and type-checks the working tree instead of the packed tarball, which is exactly what this harness exists to avoid. moduleResolution is chosen per version so the intended d.ts resolution path is exercised: TS<4.7 has no `exports`/`node16` support so it falls through package.json `typesVersions` to dist/types-ts4.2; TS>=4.7 reads the `exports.types@<4.7` / `types` conditions. `decoratorTypes:true` additionally materialises three extra fixture projects per version (stage-3, ts-legacy, babel-legacy audit) compiling the decorator member-type-preservation assertions against `@cancjs/decorators`; stage-3 (TC39) decorator syntax needs TS 5.0+, so only the 5.0 and newer lanes set it (4.2/4.7 reject the syntax).
peerDependenciesComment: Framework peers referenced by common/server-express-types.ts, common/server-fastify-types.ts, common/server-node-types.ts, common/server-hono-types.ts and common/server-koa-types.ts. Not @cancjs packages, so packPackages() never touches them; merged straight into every non-decorator fixture's package.json so `import ... from 'express'` / 'fastify' / 'hono' / 'koa' resolve inside the isolated node_modules, even in a lane that does not compile that file (an uninstalled-but-unimported package costs nothing). Pinned to the exact versions the server packages themselves devDependency-pin, so the fixture never drifts from what the shipped .d.ts were checked against.
serverTypesComment: common/server-express-types.ts, common/server-node-types.ts, common/server-fastify-types.ts, common/server-hono-types.ts and common/server-koa-types.ts compile only in versions marked serverExpressTypes / serverFastifyTypes / serverHonoTypes / serverKoaTypes (server-node rides the express gate; see each file header). None of these gates are a defect in what this repo ships: express and koa pull in @types/node dependencies that hit syntax/recursive-type limitations on TS 4.2/4.7; fastify requires NoInfer (TS 5.4+); hono requires TS 5.9+ for generic Uint8Array types. See each fixture file's own header for the measured errors.
